mapper.select: SELECT ti.video_node_id, ti.scene_id, n.asset_id AS asset_id, n.content_url AS fallback_url, NULL AS duration, ti.order_index FROM timeline_items ti JOIN nodes n ON n.id = ti.video_node_id WHERE ti.scene_id = #{sceneId} AND n.node_type = 'VIDEO' AND n.is_confirmed = 1 ORDER BY ti.order_index ASC, ti.id ASC

SELECT sv.id AS scene_video_id, ti.scene_id, s.title AS scene_title, sv.asset_id AS asset_id, sv.thumbnail_url AS fallback_url, sv.duration_ms AS duration, ti.order_index FROM timeline_items ti JOIN scenes s ON s.id = ti.scene_id JOIN scene_videos sv ON sv.id = ti.scene_video_id WHERE ti.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY ti.order_index ASC, ti.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO timeline_items ( project_id, scene_id, video_node_id, order_index, created_by ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{sceneId}, #{videoNodeId}, #{orderIndex}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.delete: DELETE ti FROM timeline_items ti JOIN nodes n ON n.id = ti.video_node_id WHERE n.parent_node_id = #{shotNodeId}
